purpose: Defines how an Adaptive Research possibility progresses from Investigable to demonstrated, engineered, mature knowledge, including setbacks, hypothesis resolution, side discoveries, pause/resume behavior, and compressed persistence.

investigable.meaning: Enough knowledge/evidence/applicability exists to organize a serious directed program.

experimental.meaning: Experiments/prototypes test the proposed mechanism outside pure theory.

demonstrated.meaning: The underlying principle works in a limited/controlled form; explicitly configured prototype capabilities can become available.

engineering.meaning: The demonstrated principle is being made reliable, manufacturable, maintainable, and operational.

mature.meaning: The civilization understands the technology well enough for normal deployment, subject to actual industrial/material/infrastructure requirements.

established_extension.description: Established science can produce delays/design failures but should not randomly become impossible.

frontier_engineering.description: Credible principle, difficult engineering. Significant setbacks or explicitly modeled hazards are possible.

scientific_hypothesis.description: The civilization is testing whether the proposed model/phenomenon is actually correct.

hazardous_foreign_or_anomalous.description: Reserved for explicitly dangerous foreign/anomalous research; ordinary late-game work does not inherit disaster risk automatically.

progress.effect: Project advances normally toward the next maturity state.

setback.effect: A failed test or engineering problem costs time/resources, but accumulated scientific knowledge is retained.

partial_success.effect: A limited subsystem or reduced-performance implementation works, increasing evidence/competence and potentially enabling an explicitly configured prototype capability.

hypothesis_supported.effect: Evidence supports the proposed phenomenon and the project can advance toward demonstration/engineering.

hypothesis_refined.effect: The original model was incomplete; preserve scientific progress and redirect/refine the project without a total reset.

hypothesis_disproven.effect: Move the tested node to Archived with resolution=disproven. Preserve negative knowledge, field competence, and possible side discoveries.

anomalous_result.effect: The expected model was not validated, but a reproducible unexplained result creates legitimate evidence/pressure for another research direction.

hazard_incident.effect: Explicitly hazardous research may damage facilities/personnel/samples/local infrastructure through the owning simulation subsystem. Research records the incident/evidence rather than directly simulating all damage.

side_discovery.effect: Unexpected work produces related evidence, a Rumored/Hypothesized possibility, field competence, or reduced uncertainty; never an unrelated mature technology.

outcome_context_inputs: foreign reference material or expert access
previous setbacks on the same project
campaign-seeded deterministic random stream where uncertainty remains

candidate_sources: direct child possibilities of tested/matured knowledge
alternative solution neighbors for the same recognized problem
strongly shared knowledge fields or solution family
other_possible_results: reduced uncertainty or contextual cost on an already visible candidate

on_mature: grant declared node capabilities according to technology_grants.json defaults/overrides
apply structural grants/deployment unlocks from technology_grants.json
